programme.title: El autoestopista
programme.desc: Dos pescadores recogen a un autoestopista que resulta ser un convicto psicótico.

programme.title: El ministerio del miedo
programme.desc: Tras dos años de reclusión, Stephen Neale abandona el sanatorio mental de Lembridge. Se encuentra entonces con un mundo distinto que nada tiene que ver con lo que él conocía.

programme.title: El doble asesinato en la calle Morgue
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, un sádico doctor de París se dedica a secuestrar a mujeres jóvenes para realizar experimentos que puedan ayudarle a confirmar sus teorías sobre la evolución del mono al hombre.

programme.title: Barba azul
programme.desc: Un peligroso asesino, apodado Barba Azul, tiene aterrorizados a los habitantes de París. A todos menos a Lucille, una modesta costurera que, desoyendo el clamor popular, decide salir a dar un paseo nocturno por la ciudad.

programme.title: Fear X
programme.desc: Harry (John Turturro), un agente de seguridad de un centro comercial, se dedica a investigar obsesivamente el asesinato de su mujer.

programme.title: La Casa Roja
programme.desc: Un anciano y su hermana ocultan un terrible secreto a su hija adolescente adoptiva, sobre una granja abandonada escondida, ubicada en lo profundo del bosque.

programme.title: La fugitiva
programme.desc: Frank Johnson se convierte en testigo ocular de un asesinato. Su esposa, la policía y el asesino lo persiguen por San Francisco.

programme.title: El malvado Zaroff
programme.desc: El conde Zaroff es un loco millonario que vive en una isla solitaria y se dedica a cazar a los náufragos como si fueran animales.

programme.title: Un cubo de sangre
programme.desc: Un ayudante de camarero tonto es aclamado como artista por un gato muerto cubierto de yeso que se confunde con una hábil estatuilla. El deseo de más elogios pronto conduce a una serie de obras cada vez más mortales.

programme.title: Ausentes
programme.desc: Julia y Samuel se mudan con los niños a una urbanización en las afueras de la ciudad. Parece un lugar ideal, pero Julia pronto descubrirá que tan idílico paraje esconde algo extraño. Se da cuenta de que la urbanización está completamente desierta.

programme.title: La Senda
programme.desc: En un intento por salvar su matrimonio, Raúl decide pasar las Navidades con su familia en una cabaña aislada en medio de la nieve. Durante la Nochebuena todo parece marchar bien, pero, de repente, la situación da un giro totalmente inesperado.

programme.title: Dictado
programme.desc: Tras quedarse huérfana, Julia es acogida por Daniel y Laura. Daniel percibe en la conducta de la niña un carácter amenazador que le trae a la memoria un pasado terrorífico que había decidido enterrar para siempre.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 3
programme.desc: El hombre de la máscara aparece de nuevo justo a tiempo de salvar a Alisha de un atracador. Alisha sale para descubrir exactamente quién es este hombre misterioso pero pronto se ve superada.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 4
programme.desc: Ollie, el nuevo chico, aparece para empezar sus trabajos para la sociedad y resultó ser que el también tiene un poder, ¿tomará la banda a un nuevo miembro?

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 5
programme.desc: No por primera vez, Nathan es violentamente asesinado. Jessica, asistente social que es todo dulzura y luz, es la principal sospechosa. Los otros están convencidos de que Simon es el próximo.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Adam es acusado de asesinato por un nuevo mutante con la capacidad de robar los recuerdos de las personas.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Un mutante con habilidades telepáticas que puede hacer que la gente experimente, mentalmente, cualquier cosa que quiera, logra meterse en la mente de Mutante X. Ahora los está haciendo experimentar sus peores miedos.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Cuando Mutante X y Genomex son capturados en una película usando sus poderes, ambos tienen que lidiar con el reportero que planea hacer pública la información.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: El ex novio de Shalimar aparece y está tratando de recuperar un huevo de Fabergé que contiene un microchip de extraordinario poder.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: El equipo intenta evitar que Eckhart adquiera un elemento raro, pero un ladrón lo consigue. La mujer que tiene la capacidad de hacer que los hombres se enamoren de ella pone su mirada en Brennan.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Mutante X se encuentra con una nueva facción de Nuevos Mutantes llamada Strand, liderada por el poderoso primer mutante Gabriel Ashlocke.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: En un intento desesperado por salvar su propia vida, Ashlocke revive a un antiguo alquimista egipcio que representa una amenaza letal para el equipo Mutante X.

programme.title: The Dresden Files: Tal para cual
programme.desc: Dresden se ocupa del caso de un chico que asegura que le acechan unos monstruos, pero un tropiezo de Harry pone a todos en peligro.

programme.title: The Dresden Files: El caso Boone
programme.desc: Dresden investiga el caso de un padre a quien se le aparece su hija, pero las circunstancias que rodean su asesinato llevan a Harry por un camino que pone en peligro a Connie.

programme.title: The Dresden Files: Un trago para la resaca
programme.desc: El FBI investiga el caso de Murphy, en el que un asesino en serie le quita el pelo y los dientes a la víctima, pero la razón podría ir más allá de coger al asesino.

programme.title: Vagrant Queen: El Templo de la Muerte
programme.desc: El equipo llega a Wix con revelaciones inesperadas. La traición conduce a un enfrentamiento sangriento.

programme.title: Vagrant Queen: Requiem por la República
programme.desc: El equipo debe arreglar su nave evitando los peligros de Wix. Lázaro comienza su ascenso al poder.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Miedo y Desprecio en la Vía Láctea
programme.desc: Gerentex está de vuelta, y exige que Trance y Harper lo ayuden con su nuevo plan: encontrar a Tarn-Vedra.
programme.sub-title: Miedo y Desprecio en la Vía Láctea

programme.title: Andrómeda: El Diablo se Lleva lo Último
programme.desc: Dylan y el reverendo Bem ayudan a una sociedad pacífica a hacer frente a sus posibles esclavos. Tienen que tener cuidado porque si Dylan les enseña a matar, sus hijos nacerán sabiendo.
programme.sub-title: El Diablo se Lleva lo Último

programme.title: Andrómeda: Cruce de Estrellas
programme.desc: El avatar de Rommie se enamora de lo que resulta ser el avatar de un buque de guerra llamado Gabriel. Gabriel intenta infectar a Rommie con un virus que difunde sus planes a la nave de guerra.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Hace una Luz Encantadora
programme.desc: Beka lleva la Andrómeda a Tarn-Vedra, pero el tiempo prolongado en la corriente de deslizamiento causa efectos secundarios. Para combatirlos, Beka comienza a tomar Flash y pronto se vuelve adicto.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Dylan y Rommie deben rescatar a Tyr, Harper y Rev de un Magog Worldship.

programme.title: Encontré al Diablo
programme.desc: Un agente secreto jura venganza contra el psicópata Kyung-chul, que asesinó a su prometida. En su cacería sangrienta, el agente se obsesiona tanto que corre el riesgo de volverse tan monstruoso como su presa.

programme.title: La noche de los muertos vivientes
programme.desc: Un grupo de personas se refugia en una casa mientras los muertos vivientes invaden el mundo.

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Vincent Vega (John Travolta) and Jules Winnfield (Samuel L. Jackson) are hitmen with a penchant for philosophical discussions. In this ultra-hip, multi-strand crime movie, their storyline is interwoven with those of their boss, gangster Marsellus Wallace (Ving Rhames) his actress wife, Mia (Uma Thurman) struggling boxer Butch Coolidge (Bruce Willis) master fixer Winston Wolfe (Harvey Keitel) and a nervous pair of armed robbers, "Pumpkin" (Tim Roth) and "Honey Bunny" (Amanda Plummer).

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: After building an empire with bootleg alcohol, legendary crime boss Al Capone (Robert De Niro) rules Chicago with an iron fist. Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness (Kevin Costner) attempts to take Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force. Recruiting an elite group of lawmen who won't be swayed by bribes or fear, including Irish-American cop Jimmy Malone (Sean Connery), Ness renews his determination to bring Capone to justice.

programme.title: The Call
programme.desc: 911 operator races against the clock to the save the life of a victim calling her from the trunk of a car.

programme.title: The Perfect Guy
programme.desc: A woman who meets an IT expert, who seems to be the perfect guy.

programme.title: Life

programme.title: Krull
programme.desc: In a fantasy adventure, set in a world peopled by creatures of myth and magic, a prince embarks on a quest.

programme.title: A Man for All Seasons
programme.desc: When the highly respected British statesman Sir Thomas More (Paul Scofield) refuses to pressure the Pope into annulling the marriage of King Henry VIII (Robert Shaw) and his Spanish-born wife, More's clashes with the monarch increase in intensity. A devout Catholic, More stands by his religious principles and moves to leave the royal court. Unfortunately, the King and his loyalists aren't appeased by this, and press forward with grave charges of treason, further testing More's resolve.

programme.title: Fire Down Below
programme.desc: Set in the Caribbean, U.S. expatriates Tony and Felix cruise around the ocean and eke out a meager subsistence using their small trawling boat to transport cargo. When they take on the job of smuggling illegal-immigrant beauty Irena to another island, the two friends find their friendship torn apart by their mutual romantic feelings toward her. Though jealousy has split them apart, fate intervenes to bring the two back together.

programme.title: The Cockleshell Heroes
programme.desc: Maj. Stringer (Jose Ferrer) needs to assemble a crack squad of British Royal Marines for a highly unusual mission. Though Capt. Thompson (Trevor Howard) is extremely skeptical, he dutifully helps his new superior recruit and train the needed men. Their audacious plan involves transporting a small group of soldiers by submarine to the coast of occupied France, where they will kayak along an estuary into a Nazi shipyard and commit sabotage. Chances for success are very small.

programme.title: Tell It to the Judge
programme.desc: Marsha Meredith (Rosalind Russell) has just been offered a position as a federal judge. Much to her dismay, her nomination is challenged on the grounds that her divorce renders her unsuitable for the courtroom. Desperate to win the position, Marsha arranges a fake marriage to Alexander (Gig Young), even though she still has feelings for Peter (Robert Cummings), her ex-husband. Marsha and Alexander -- and Marsha and Peter -- soon find themselves in a series of compromising situations.

programme.title: Mission
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt, a secret agent, is framed for the deaths of his espionage team and attempts to flee government assassins after him. He races against the clock in order to discover the truth.

programme.title: Mission
programme.desc: The world's greatest spy, Ethan Hunt, returns and partners up with the beautiful Nyah Hall to stop renegade agent Sean Ambrose from releasing a new kind of terror on an unsuspecting world.

programme.title: Mission
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt hurdles into spectacular new adventures from Rome to Shanghai as he races to rescue a captured agent and stop Davian from eliminating his next target, Ethan's wife.

programme.title: Unfriended: Dark Web
programme.desc: After finding a laptop, a young man goes online to play a game with five of his good friends. He shows them a mysterious folder that plays disturbing videos of people who appear to be in danger. They then receive an anonymous message that tells them they will all die if they disconnect or call the police. The planned night of fun quickly turns deadly as each user becomes the target of something sinister while the others watch helplessly in terror.

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Ex-FBI agent Will Graham (Edward Norton) is an expert investigator who quit the Bureau after almost losing his life in the process of capturing the elusive Dr. Lecter (Anthony Hopkins). After a series of particularly grisly murders, Graham soon realizes that the best way to catch this killer, known as the Tooth Fairy, is to find a way to get inside the killer's mind. For Graham, that means confronting his past and facing his former nemesis, the now-incarcerated Lecter.

programme.title: Split
programme.desc: Though Kevin has evidenced 23 personalities to his trusted psychiatrist, Dr. Fletcher, there remains one still submerged who is set to materialize and dominate all the others. Compelled to abduct three teenage girls led by the willful, observant Casey, Kevin reaches a war for survival among all of those contained within him -- as well as everyone around him -- as the walls between his compartments shatter.

programme.title: The Hitcher
programme.desc: Grace and Jim are a pair of college students on their way to spring break in a 1970 Oldsmobile. Blissfully unaware of the horror that awaits them, they offer a ride to hitchhiker John Ryder, a killer who subsequently terrorizes the couple and implicates them in a grisly slaying.

programme.title: João Bosco
programme.desc: The vibrant island of Malta was in for a night of light and cheerful music when Brazilian music legend João Bosco took the stage on July 21, 2018. The self-taught guitarist made his music debut in the 1970s alongside Elis Regina and Aldir Blanc. In 2018, with guitarist Ricardo Silveira, bassist João Baptista and drummer Kiko Freitas, Bosco introduces us to his trademark melting pot of bossa nova, samba and MPB, sparingly influenced by contemporary jazz. Following his phenomenal successes in his native Brazil, the enthusiasm of the Maltese crowd underlines that João Bosco is now gradually achieving his long-overdue recognition elsewhere.

programme.title: Buddy Rich, Tom Warrington, Bob Kaye & John Marshall
programme.sub-title: Buddy Rich Big Band - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Buddy Rich, one of the most influential jazz drummers of all time, performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1978 with his orchestra. Rich's drumming was known for its remarkable speed and dexterity, which he achieved without any formal education.

programme.title: Buster Williams
programme.sub-title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond
programme.desc: For the 40th anniversary of jazz legend Miles Davis' legendary album Bitches Brew, trumpeter Wallace Roney leads a band that revives the master's music. This project is the brainchild of Miles' family (including his son Erin), which is represented by his nephew, drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at the ancient theater in Vienne, France, is a grand tribute to Miles.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Joe Zawinul, Steve Khan, Victor Bailey & Peter Erskine
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1986, jazz-fusion band “Weather Update” was one of the bands appearing here. This short-lived band was formed by Austrian keyboardist Joe Zawinul in 1986, following the breakup of his famous “Weather Report” band. Again led by Zawinul, Weather Update consisted of Victor Bailey on bass, Peter Erskine and Robert Thomas Jr. on percussion instruments, and Steve Khan on guitar.

programme.title: Count Basie
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Quincy Jones, Porter Kilbert, Phil Woods & Budd Johnson
programme.desc: ‘Jazz Icons: Quincy Jones' spotlights a young ‘Q' conducting his ‘dream band'—an 18-piece orchestra of world-renowned players such as Clark Terry, Phil Woods, Sahib Shihab, Budd Johnson and Benny Bailey. This recording features 5 songs and is one of the finest examples of big band jazz ever to be captured on film. Shot in Belgium in 1961, this concert is one of the only known visual documents of this legendary tour.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Zhu Xiao-Mei
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church, where Bach spent most time of his career as 'Thomaskantor', the musical director of the Thomanerchor church choir. The Goldberg Variations consist of one aria and a set of 30 variations. The work was first published in 1741 and was named after harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg. In contrast to melodic variations on a theme, the Goldberg Variations do not follow the melody, but rather use the aria's bass line and chord progression. Every third variation in the series of 30 is a canon that follows an ascending pattern. The Goldberg Variations are among Bach's most celebrated works, which gained an even larger audience thanks to Glenn Gould's legendary recordings of the work in 1955 and 1981.

programme.title: Ballet of the Mariinsky Theatre
programme.desc: 'La Bayadère' is a three-act ballet by the French choreographer Marius Petipa. Set in 19th-century India, 'La Bayadère' tells the sad love story of the noble warrior Solor and his Nikia, a temple dancer or 'bayadère', who is poisoned by her rival, Gamzatti. The ballet features one of the most celebrated scenes of classical ballet, namely 'The Kingdom of the Shades'. In this iconic scene, Solor dreams, under the influence of opium, of reuniting with his beloved Nikia. This production of the ballet features the revised choreography by Vladimir Ponomarev and Vakhtang Chabukiani (1941), and includes dances by Konstantin Sergeyev and Nikolai Zubkovsky. The ballet's music, composed by Ludwig Minkus, is performed by the Mariinsky Orchestra under the direction of Boris Gruzin. Among the performers are Viktoria Tereshkina, Anastasia Matvienko, Vladimir Shklyarov, and Vladimir Ponomarev. This performance was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg, Russia, in July 2014.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: The Rückert-Lieder are a collection of five art songs by Mahler, set to poems by Friedrich Rückert, showcasing his gift for intimate and deeply personal musical expression in a style that balances simplicity with profound emotional complexity, often exploring themes of nature, loss, and transcendence. The songs offer a rare glimpse into Mahler's soul, revealing a deep sensitivity and the gift of expressing complex human feelings with an exquisite and seemingly simple musical beauty.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen & Pascal Amoyel
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

programme.desc: On March 14, 2009, Journey returned to Arnel Pineda's homeland and introduced him as their newest lead singer to a crowd of nearly 30,000 at the SM Mall of Asia Concert Grounds. Features songs such as Don't Stop Believin', Stone In Love, When You Love A Woman and Separate Ways.

programme.title: J Balvin
programme.desc: J. Balvin returns to his hometown of Medellín, Colombia to perform a special anniversary concert entitled "BRUUTTAL". A musical journey that begins with his early songs and ends with his most recent, multi-platinum album, " Energía.” This spectacular show was performed and filmed to express J. Balvin's gratitude to his fans. J. Balvin succeeded in making this one-time show spectacular by assembling other Latin urban music legends including Nicky Jam, Yandel, Farruko, Zion y Lennox, Jowell y Randy, among others, to join him on stage. J. Balvin sang his hit songs “6 AM,” “Safari,” “Ginza,” and “Ay Vamos.”

programme.title: Ozzy Osbourne
programme.desc: Ozzy Osbourne is one of the most iconic figures in rock and one of the founding fathers of heavy metal. "God Bless Ozzy Osbourne" tells for the first time the story of his career from the founding of Black Sabbath through to solo stardom and his wider fame beyond. These were the wild days of his prodigious drug and alcohol intake, of biting the head from a dove at a record company meeting and biting into a bat on stage but also of the tragic death of Randy Rhoads and the reality TV show The Osbournes. The film follows Ozzy's torturous and emotionally fraught journey from excess to sobriety, which Ozzy regards as his greatest accomplishment. Featuring never before seen footage, new interviews with Ozzy himself, his family, his bandmates, and those who both inspired him and were inspired by him, this is the first film to take viewers inside the mind and psyche of this legendary figure.

'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. programme.title: João Bosco
programme.desc: The vibrant island of Malta was in for a night of light and cheerful music when Brazilian music legend João Bosco took the stage on July 21, 2018. The self-taught guitarist made his music debut in the 1970s alongside Elis Regina and Aldir Blanc. In 2018, with guitarist Ricardo Silveira, bassist João Baptista and drummer Kiko Freitas, Bosco introduces us to his trademark melting pot of bossa nova, samba and MPB, sparingly influenced by contemporary jazz. Following his phenomenal successes in his native Brazil, the enthusiasm of the Maltese crowd underlines that João Bosco is now gradually achieving his long-overdue recognition elsewhere.

programme.title: Buddy Rich, Tom Warrington, Bob Kaye & John Marshall
programme.sub-title: Buddy Rich Big Band - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Buddy Rich, one of the most influential jazz drummers of all time, performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1978 with his orchestra. Rich's drumming was known for its remarkable speed and dexterity, which he achieved without any formal education.

programme.title: Buster Williams
programme.sub-title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond
programme.desc: For the 40th anniversary of jazz legend Miles Davis' legendary album Bitches Brew, trumpeter Wallace Roney leads a band that revives the master's music. This project is the brainchild of Miles' family (including his son Erin), which is represented by his nephew, drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at the ancient theater in Vienne, France, is a grand tribute to Miles.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Joe Zawinul, Steve Khan, Victor Bailey & Peter Erskine
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1986, jazz-fusion band “Weather Update” was one of the bands appearing here. This short-lived band was formed by Austrian keyboardist Joe Zawinul in 1986, following the breakup of his famous “Weather Report” band. Again led by Zawinul, Weather Update consisted of Victor Bailey on bass, Peter Erskine and Robert Thomas Jr. on percussion instruments, and Steve Khan on guitar.

programme.title: Count Basie
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn's 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz's future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer's performance was a reminder of jazz's enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn's concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Quincy Jones, Porter Kilbert, Phil Woods & Budd Johnson
programme.desc: ‘Jazz Icons: Quincy Jones' spotlights a young ‘Q' conducting his ‘dream band'—an 18-piece orchestra of world-renowned players such as Clark Terry, Phil Woods, Sahib Shihab, Budd Johnson and Benny Bailey. This recording features 5 songs and is one of the finest examples of big band jazz ever to be captured on film. Shot in Belgium in 1961, this concert is one of the only known visual documents of this legendary tour.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Zhu Xiao-Mei
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church, where Bach spent most time of his career as 'Thomaskantor', the musical director of the Thomanerchor church choir. The Goldberg Variations consist of one aria and a set of 30 variations. The work was first published in 1741 and was named after harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg. In contrast to melodic variations on a theme, the Goldberg Variations do not follow the melody, but rather use the aria's bass line and chord progression. Every third variation in the series of 30 is a canon that follows an ascending pattern. The Goldberg Variations are among Bach's most celebrated works, which gained an even larger audience thanks to Glenn Gould's legendary recordings of the work in 1955 and 1981.

programme.title: Ballet of the Mariinsky Theatre
programme.desc: 'La Bayadère' is a three-act ballet by the French choreographer Marius Petipa. Set in 19th-century India, 'La Bayadère' tells the sad love story of the noble warrior Solor and his Nikia, a temple dancer or 'bayadère', who is poisoned by her rival, Gamzatti. The ballet features one of the most celebrated scenes of classical ballet, namely 'The Kingdom of the Shades'. In this iconic scene, Solor dreams, under the influence of opium, of reuniting with his beloved Nikia. This production of the ballet features the revised choreography by Vladimir Ponomarev and Vakhtang Chabukiani (1941), and includes dances by Konstantin Sergeyev and Nikolai Zubkovsky. The ballet's music, composed by Ludwig Minkus, is performed by the Mariinsky Orchestra under the direction of Boris Gruzin. Among the performers are Viktoria Tereshkina, Anastasia Matvienko, Vladimir Shklyarov, and Vladimir Ponomarev. This performance was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg, Russia, in July 2014.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: The Rückert-Lieder are a collection of five art songs by Mahler, set to poems by Friedrich Rückert, showcasing his gift for intimate and deeply personal musical expression in a style that balances simplicity with profound emotional complexity, often exploring themes of nature, loss, and transcendence. The songs offer a rare glimpse into Mahler's soul, revealing a deep sensitivity and the gift of expressing complex human feelings with an exquisite and seemingly simple musical beauty.

programme.title: Jan Latham-Koenig, Symfonieorkest Vlaanderen & Pascal Amoyel
programme.sub-title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture. Next on the program is Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16, featuring Pascal Amoyel as the pianist. It is the composer's only concerto. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. The program ends with Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92. The work is very popular, especially because of its touching second movement. At the Allegretto's 1813 premiere, the audience demanded an immediate encore.

programme.title: Journey
programme.desc: On March 14, 2009, Journey returned to Arnel Pineda's homeland and introduced him as their newest lead singer to a crowd of nearly 30,000 at the SM Mall of Asia Concert Grounds. Features songs such as Don't Stop Believin', Stone In Love, When You Love A Woman and Separate Ways.

programme.title: J Balvin
programme.desc: J. Balvin returns to his hometown of Medellín, Colombia to perform a special anniversary concert entitled "BRUUTTAL". A musical journey that begins with his early songs and ends with his most recent, multi-platinum album, " Energía.” This spectacular show was performed and filmed to express J. Balvin's gratitude to his fans. J. Balvin succeeded in making this one-time show spectacular by assembling other Latin urban music legends including Nicky Jam, Yandel, Farruko, Zion y Lennox, Jowell y Randy, among others, to join him on stage. J. Balvin sang his hit songs “6 AM,” “Safari,” “Ginza,” and “Ay Vamos.”

programme.title: Ozzy Osbourne
programme.desc: Ozzy Osbourne is one of the most iconic figures in rock and one of the founding fathers of heavy metal. "God Bless Ozzy Osbourne" tells for the first time the story of his career from the founding of Black Sabbath through to solo stardom and his wider fame beyond. These were the wild days of his prodigious drug and alcohol intake, of biting the head from a dove at a record company meeting and biting into a bat on stage but also of the tragic death of Randy Rhoads and the reality TV show The Osbournes. The film follows Ozzy's torturous and emotionally fraught journey from excess to sobriety, which Ozzy regards as his greatest accomplishment. Featuring never before seen footage, new interviews with Ozzy himself, his family, his bandmates, and those who both inspired him and were inspired by him, this is the first film to take viewers inside the mind and psyche of this legendary figure.

programme.title: Metallica
programme.sub-title: Orion Festival: Tour Through the Never
programme.desc: Filmed at Orion Festival, Atlantic City, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Metallica featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'One', 'Master Of Puppets', 'Sad But True', 'Seek & Destroy' and many more.

programme.title: Volvemos pronto con más contenido
programme.desc: ¡Estamos recuperando el sueño perdido! Permanece atento a la magnífica selección de entretenimiento de Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Falling
programme.desc: John vive con su novio Eric y la hija adoptiva de ambos en el sur de California. Su padre Willis un granjero tradicional y conservador de 80 años, decide viajar a Los Ángeles y quedarse en casa de John mientras busca el lugar idóneo para jubilarse.

programme.title: Un nuevo mundo
programme.desc: Philippe, directivo de una gran empresa, y su esposa se separan. Su relación no ha resistido a las presiones del trabajo. Tras décadas en el cargo, Philippe ya no sabe cómo responder a las demandas incoherentes de su compañía. Llega el momento de hacer balance, y decidir el sentido de su vida.

programme.title: Amor Sin Tiempo
programme.desc: Megan parece tener la vida perfecta: una relación amorosa con un maravilloso esposo y dos adorables hijos.

programme.title: No Quiero Ser Recuerdo
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su madre, Vega conoce a alguien que devolverá el color a su vida.

programme.title: El Principe Enamorado
programme.desc: El Príncipe Carlos llega a la Costa Brava con la intención de pasar unas semanas de descanso.

programme.title: Princesa en el paraíso
programme.desc: El rey Edvard y la reina Paige vuelan a la boda concertada de la princesa Myra, quien ama a un chico humilde.

programme.title: Palm Springs
programme.desc: Dos desconocidos atrapados en un bucle temporal.

programme.title: La balada de la mala suerte
programme.desc: Jesse es un músico fracasado que se encuentra en una encrucijada existencial cuando las malas decisiones lo alcanzan durante una reunión inesperada con Carla, un viejo amor.

programme.title: El fin del sexo (The End of Sex)
programme.desc: Una pareja que siente las presiones de la paternidad y la edad adulta envía a sus hijos a un campamento de invierno por primera vez y se embarca en una serie de aventuras sexuales para revitalizar su relación.

programme.title: Remember Me
programme.desc: Claude, un hombre viudo de unos setenta años, que vive solo y está desencantado con su única hija, se entera un día de que LILLIAN, la mujer que fue el el primer amor de su vida tiene Alzheimer y está ingresada en una residencia especializada.

programme.title: Fiebre de boda
programme.desc: Dahlia Marchand, la más popular novelista romántica, le gusta ser casamentera, y está decidida a ayudar a su adorable editora a encontrar al "Señor Perfecto" para ella.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Un joven licenciado de origen humilde se convierte en secretario y persona de confianza de un acaudalado empresario, quien dirige su propia fábrica de acero. A medida que su relación laboral se estrecha, el joven deberá acudir al domicilio del empresario, donde conocerá a su preciosa joven mujer.

programme.title: Fortunata
programme.desc: Una joven madre, con un matrimonio fallido a sus espaldas, hace lo posible por luchar día tras día para alcanzar su sueño: abrir una peluquería con la que desafiar a su destino, en un intento de emanciparse y conquistar la independencia y su derecho a la felicidad.

programme.title: Black death (Garra negra)
programme.desc: La Inglaterra medieval ha caído bajo la sombra de la peste. Un joven monje llamado Osmund recibe el encargo de guiar a un intrépido caballero, Ulric, y a su grupo de mercenarios hasta un remoto pantano. El objetivo de su viaje es encontrar a una persona que puede devolver la vida a los muertos. Dividido entre su amor por Dios y el de una joven, Osmund descubre que esa persona es una hermosa mujer llamada Langiva.

programme.title: Borg McEnroe. La película
programme.desc: Wimbledon 1980, el sueco imperturbable Björn Borg y el temperamental norteamericano John McEnroe se enfrentan en una final legendaria que marca la historia del tenis. Dos iconos de este deporte completamente opuestos que se convirtieron en leyenda. Fuego y hielo en la pista. La película que recrea una de las mayores rivalidades deportivas de todos los tiempos.

programme.title: Barbacoa de amigos
programme.desc: Para su cincuenta cumpleaños, Antoine recibe un regalo bastante desagradable: un ataque al corazón. A partir de ahora, va a tener que empezar a ser más cauteloso. Pero Antoine ha pasado toda su vida siendo cauteloso, cuidando su salud, su dieta y dedicándose con esmero a cuidar de su familia y amigos. Ahora Antoine quiere cambiar las cosas. Y hace precisamente eso... cambiar su vida y la de aquellos a su alrededor.

programme.title: American night
programme.desc: Michael Rubino, que acaba de convertirse en el Don de la mafia de la ciudad de Nueva York, sueña en secreto con convertirse en…

programme.title: Todo Me Pasa A Mí
programme.desc: El regreso de un amigo de la India hace que un grupo de jóvenes se cuestione sus relaciones.

programme.title: Villa Bella
programme.desc: Tres mujeres de diferentes caminos se unen como cuidadoras en un hogar de ancianos y encuentran amistad.

programme.title: Freaked
programme.desc: Un actor vanidoso y su mejor amigo en una granja de monstruos mutantes.

programme.title: Cambio de rumbo
programme.desc: Rupert tiene 24 horas para cambiar radicalmente su vida o perder a Alison, la mujer a la que ama.

programme.title: Todo Me Pasa A Mí
programme.desc: El regreso de un amigo de la India hace que un grupo de jóvenes se cuestione sus relaciones.

programme.title: Diario de un ejecutivo agresivo
programme.desc: Jack es un agente literario con una exitosa trayectoria profesional. De repente su vida da un vuelco: se entera de que su mujer lo engaña con su mejor cliente, le roban en su casa y le dan una paliza.

programme.title: Furlough
programme.desc: Se centra en una mujer (Thompson) que vive con su madre (Goldberg) al mismo tiempo que trabaja en una cárcel. En el trabajo tendrá la oportunidad de demostrar sus habilidades cuando se le asigna la tarea de acompañar a un prisionero que tiene permiso para visitar a su madre que se muere.

programme.title: Boda en top end
programme.desc: Lauren y Ned están prometidos y tienen 10 días para encontrar a la madre de Lauren, que ha desaparecido, reunir a sus padres, y tener la boda de sus sueños.

programme.title: Negocios con resaca
programme.desc: Desmadre de comedia gamberra y transgresora con Vince Vaughn como el sufrido dueño de un pequeño negocio quien, junto con sus dos socios, viajan a Europa para cerrar el acuerdo más importante de sus vidas. Pero lo que comenzó como un viaje de negocios de rutina descarrila en inimaginables caminos.

programme.title: Lucky
programme.desc: El viaje espiritual de un hombre de noventa años. Con una salud de hierro, Lucky ha sobrevivido más que sus contemporáneos, lo que le anima a replantearse su vida y buscar una “revelación”.

programme.title: Hunt For The Wilderpeople
programme.desc: Un niño rebelde y su atolondrado tío adoptivo, quienes se adentran en el bosque luego de una tragedia familiar, ignorantes que su misteriosa desaparición marcará el inicio de una intensa persecución de parte de las autoridades.

programme.title: El Tesoro De Curly
programme.desc: En esta secuela del gran éxito de taquilla, el neoyorquino Mitch Robbins (Billy Crystal) y su hermano Glen (Jon Lovitz), la oveja negra de la familia, encuentran por accidente un antiguo mapa del tesoro oculto en la cinta del sombrero del difunto Curly. Después de visitar la biblioteca local, descubren que el padre de Curly participó en un célebre robo a un tren.

programme.title: ¿Qué Pasó Anoche?
programme.desc: Dos parejas que se conocen una noche en un bar y se sienten atraídas mutuamente. El juego de seducción comienza, pero en el largo camino entre el local y el dormitorio, la realidad se va abriendo paso.

programme.title: Superpoli De Centro Comercial
programme.desc: Paul Blart es un padre soltero del extrarradio. Intenta ganarse la vida como guardia de seguridad en un gran centro comercial de Nueva Jersey. A pesar de que nadie toma su trabajo en serio, Paul considera que está al frente de la seguridad del recinto. Cuando un atraco cierra las puertas del centro comercial, el oficial de seguridad más extraordinario de Jersey tendrá que convertirse en un policía de verdad para poder salvar la situación.

programme.title: Hellgate: La puerta del infierno
programme.desc: Un hombre es falsamente acusado de espionaje y enviado a la brutal prisión de Hellgate. Tras un fallido intento de fuga, es condenado al aislamiento. Cuando una plaga asola la prisión, encuentra una inesperada redención en medio del caos.

programme.title: Sitting Bull: Casta de guerreros
programme.desc: Sitting Bull, líder de los Sioux, se ve obligado por el general Custer a reaccionar violentamente, lo que lleva a la famosa batalla en Little Bighorn. Parrish, un amigo de los Sioux, intenta evitar la sangre derramada pero es acusado de colaborar con el enemigo. Sitting Bull intercede ante el presidente Grant para salvarlo.

programme.title: La primera ametralladora del Oeste
programme.desc: Un hombre secuestra a la esposa de un comandante de caballería para intercambiarla por una pistola Gatling que está siendo vendida por un traficante de armas.

programme.title: Ana Caulder
programme.desc: Tras ser brutalmente atacada y perder a su esposo, Hannie Caulder jura venganza contra los tres forajidos responsables. Con la ayuda del cazarrecompensas Thomas Price, aprende a manejar un arma y se convierte en una pistolera letal. Mientras los hermanos Clemens continúan su ola de crímenes, Hannie se prepara para enfrentarlos y hacer justicia.

programme.title: Viven Entre Nosotros
programme.desc: A humanidade descobre que o vampirismo é um vírus real e que vampiros convivem entre nós. Para melhorar a relação entre espécies, uma família vampira aceita ser filmada por três documentaristas. Mas, enquanto revelam seu dia a dia “comum”, segredos surgem e intenções ocultas começam a ameaçar a frágil confiança.

programme.title: Un caballo de Regalo
programme.desc: Una joven afligida trabaja en el rancho local propiedad de un magnate de los negocios, cuando llega un nuevo caballo y ella aprovecha la oportunidad para recuperar su fe entrenándolo para ganar.

programme.title: Una novia muy especial
programme.desc: Dos amigos de la infancia se reencuentran para ayudarse a conquistar a las mujeres de sus sueños. Chris finge ser judío para enamorar a Allison, mientras Adam duda de su inminente boda. Entre mentiras y choques culturales, todo se complica.

programme.title: Suburbios del Alma
programme.desc: Clara y Miguel se cruzan, Luis y Viviana luchan por conectar con su hijo Marcos, y Lorena descubre la dureza del mundo. El mar y la arena observan cómo estas vidas se entrelazan, revelando los secretos más profundos de sus corazones.

programme.title: Red Dog
programme.desc: Adaptación de la novela Louis De Bernieres basada en un hecho real, narra como un perro kelpie australiano se une a una comunidad minera durante los años setenta.

programme.title: El pequeño Nicolás
programme.desc: Inclinados sobre un gran folio en blanco en algún lugar entre Montmartre y Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Jean-Jacques Sempé y René Goscinny dan vida a El pequeño Nicolás, un niño risueño y travieso. La suya es una infancia alegre, llena de juegos, diversión, bromas, aprendizaje, complicidad, peleas y castigos. Las aventuras de Nicolás le llevan al estudio de sus creadores, donde habla con ellos de forma distendida. Sempé y Goscinny le cuentan cómo se conocieron y se hicieron amigos, y también responden a preguntas sobre su carrera, su infancia y sus ambiciones.

programme.title: Arthur 3: La guerra de los mundos
programme.desc: “Tercera y última entrega de la trilogía de Arthur y los Minimoys. Maltazard ha conseguido colarse en el mundo de los humanos. Su objetivo es sencillo: reclutar un ejército de gigantescos secuaces y dominar el universo. Arthur parece ser el único capaz de frustrar sus planes, pero primero tendrá que volver a su habitación... y recuperar su tamaño normal.” Aunque sigue atrapado en un diminuto cuerpo de minimoy, contará con la ayuda de Selenia y Betameche, y, sorprendentemente, también la de Darkos, el hijo de Maltazard, que afirma estar de su lado. A pie, en bici, en coche o incluso en una Harley Davidson, Arthur y sus amigos emplearán cualquier medio a su alcance para librar su batalla final contra Maltazard.

programme.title: La casa del río
programme.desc: Una enfermera de un pequeño pueblo lidera a sus vecinos de clase obrera en su lucha por salvar sus hogares frente a los intereses políticos y corporativos que quieren dar la tierra a la Pfizer Corporation.

programme.title: Cazador Blanco
programme.desc: Un veterano retirado que está de caza en el norte de Maine se encuentra por accidente con el cadáver de una mujer y una cuantiosa suma de dinero.

programme.title: El lute: Camina o revienta
programme.desc: Eleuterio Sánchez “El Lute” aprovecha un traslado para fugarse. Desde ese momento, será perseguido por la Guardia Civil.

programme.title: María (y los demás)
programme.desc: Desde que murió su madre, María ha cuidado de su padre y de sus hermanos. Responsable y controladora, siempre ha sido el pilar de la familia y se siente orgullosa de ello. Por eso, cuando su padre anuncia que se casa con Cachita, su simpática enfermera, María siente que su mundo se desmorona.

programme.title: Benidorm mon amour
programme.desc: Tonet aprovecha un permiso de la mili para ir en coche con sus amigos Sento, Jaume y Tomy a Benidorm. Sueñan con disfrutar unos días del sol, las playas y, sobre todo, de las suecas y sus biquinis.

programme.title: La final
programme.desc: Tres amigos hinchas del Atlético Madrid y tres chicas seguidoras del Real Madrid: todos protagonizan una historia de amor la semana de la final de Champions. Aure y Andrea tienen una tensión sexual no resuelta desde la adolescencia, fruto de la casualidad, surge el reencuentro.

programme.title: The Sadist
programme.desc: Three teachers are treated to an afternoon of horror when a maniacal killer interrupts their trip to Dodger Stadium.

programme.title: El monstruo humano AKA The Human Monster
programme.desc: Agente de seguros-medico cobra polizas de hombres asesinados por un residente desfigurado del hogar para ciegos donde actua como medico de guardia.

programme.title: Parasite
programme.desc: Paul Dean has created a deadly parasite that is now attached to his stomach. He and his female companion, Patricia Welles, must find a way to destroy it while also trying to avoid Ricus, his rednecks, and an evil government agent named Merchant.

programme.title: Billy The Kid Versus Dracula
programme.desc: Dracula travels to the American West, intent on making a beautiful ranch owner his next victim. Her fiance, outlaw Billy the Kid, finds out about it and rushes to save her.

programme.title: Sultanes
programme.desc: Una banda de ladrones roba en un banco mexicano y viaja a Argentina para blanquear el dinero. A su llegada, el plan se tuerce y les toca a ellos averiguar qué salió mal.

programme.title: Asalto al Cine
programme.desc: Unos jóvenes en México planean un atraco a un cine, sin saber que sus vidas van a cambiar drásticamente tras el crimen.

programme.title: Megalodon Rising
programme.desc: Cuando el mayor depredador acuático de la historia regresa, la armada de modernos buques de guerra enviada para destruirlo no tiene ninguna posibilidad.

programme.title: Esto no es un atracto
programme.desc: Dos chicos de instituto que no consiguen ligar son víctimas de una broma de dos chicas.

programme.title: Sobrevive esta noche
programme.desc: Frank (Bruce Willis), y su hijo están enfrentados, pero deberá dejar las rencillas a un lado y unir fuerzas para sobrevivir y salir con vida de su casa cuando dos criminales que huyen de un robo a mano armada, asaltan su hogar y fuerzan a la familia de Frank a convertirse en rehenes.

programme.title: Isolation

programme.title: Los Cuatro Guerreros
